_comment: This declaration authorizes exactly 0.10.0-preview.3. The latest SemVer-compatible repository tag is v0.4.2, so the maintainer must set version_override to this exact target.
The new v0.10 product scope is the completed CQRS/messaging/web/API annotation family (#570) and bounded context metadata composition (#572).
The candidate also includes the required real-consumer read-only diagnostics correction tracked by #1084.

The v0.10 contract (#566), layered/DDD annotations (#569), repository metrics and Structure badge correction (#1057), and audit applicability correction (#1061) are prior-preview context, not new preview.3 blockers.

The source-only package (#567), full classifier/catalog integration (#568), remaining infrastructure/UI/Unity annotations (#571), adoption guidance (#573), and packed-artifact stable-release gate (#574) remain excluded. In particular, #574 is still required before stable 0.10.0.

required_items.summary: Add the reviewed first-class CQRS, messaging, and web/API semantic annotation families
Compose the reviewed bounded context metadata while retaining one-primary-role semantics
Preserve receipt-backed read-only diagnostics and fail closed when topology observation is incomplete

excluded_items.reason: The source-only annotation package distribution and complete approved annotation set remain open; preview.3 does not claim finished package adoption.
Full classifier/catalog parity and integration acceptance remain open; preview.3 does not claim this issue complete.
Infrastructure, UI, and Unity role families remain separate open v0.10 work and are not required for preview.3.
Annotation-first adoption, migration, compatibility, and AI-authoring guidance remain open and are not required for this early preview.
Packed external-consumer acceptance remains the gate for stable v0.10.0; preview.3 does not claim that gate or stable-release completion.

delivered_items.reason: The v0.10 annotation contract was delivered in an earlier preview; it is cumulative context, not new preview.3 scope.
Layered/DDD annotation sources were delivered in an earlier preview; they are cumulative context, not new preview.3 scope.
The repository metrics and Structure badge-depth correction was delivered in an earlier preview; it is not new preview.3 scope.
The audit-only applicability gate correction was delivered in preview.2; it is not new preview.3 scope.
